title: Hayati Pro Max Plus Fizzy Cherry Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Fizzy Cherry brings together ripe, juicy Cherry sweetness with a lively soda sparkle. The result is a bright, playful Cherry vape balanced by gentle effervescence and a light cooling undertone. Each Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod includes a prefilled 2ml pod and an integrated 10ml refill reservoir, giving a total of 12ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid. There’s no need to refill manually or change coils—simply attach to the Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod Kit and vape. Powered by a dual mesh coil, each pod delivers up to 6000 puffs (approx.) of consistent vapour and flavour. Replace once performance declines for the best results. Discover more flavours with our full selection of Hayati Pro Max Plus Pods .
